items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: No, I never heard Papai and them, I never heard them.

ctx.x: Well, I'm going to tell you, that's a hard thing to say because, but I can give you five or six good clarinet players, without putting that temper, I couldn't judge them because that's, I think T.O. was one of the T.O.
Did you hear his uncles and his father play? No, I never heard Papai and them, I never heard them.
And Basso and all them for the, and Ashil Bakay, he was a nice clarinet player, the white band.
